name: Matralina Pati

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Matralina Pati is a poet, researcher and translator working between Bengali and English. Her literary biographies describe research into marginal Bhasha literatures in English translation at Bankura University. She translated Rudra Pati’s Bengali poems for ‘Monsoon Seems Promising This Year’, bringing another poet’s work into conversation with her own writing.

Her Kabita Live poems question what can be measured and what remains concealed. ‘The Insoluble Sum’ turns calculation into an image of life’s resistance to explanation; the accompanying ‘Deaths and the Accountant’ sharpens that image into a critique of reducing lives to accounts. ‘Bubbles within’ gives loss a fragile, vanishing form, while ‘Matrimony’ contrasts public vows with a truth kept out of sight.
